description:
Use this when the user wants valuation and returns across the stocks in an Indian index at a glance. Not for ranking by return; use get_top_movers.

Returns each stock in an index with market cap, P/E, P/B and its return over 1 day, 1 week and 1, 3, 6 and 12 months, largest company first. `index` is an index name such as NIFTY 50; a name that is not recognised returns the valid ones. `limit` is 1 to 500 (default 100). The order is by size and cannot be changed: to rank by the day's move use get_top_movers.

index.description: Index name, e.g. "NIFTY 50" or "BSE SENSEX" (a name, not a slug).
index.title: Index
